Court Stacking Guide (Global Debuffs)
source.note: Some debuffs override others regardless of value, e.g. Divinity over Particle Reconstruction. See docs/mechanics/damage-stacking.md.

source.name: Court Stacking Guide (Weapon Surges: "the highest same-Element Surge always takes priority")
source.note: Model each surge level (2x, 3x, 4x) as its own effect.

source.name: Court Stacking Guide (Damage Buff Categories, Amplification Modifiers: "Stacks with all other buffs and itself")
source.note: Exception: melee-increasing modifiers are additive (Court: "Melee-increasing damage modifiers are additive"). No melee buff is modelled yet.

Destiny Data Compendium, Game Mechanics (Melee stat: "Damage increase is multiplicative")
source.note: Stated for the melee stat; assumed for the super and grenade stats. Only one stat applies per ability, so the stacking rule inside the bucket does not matter.
